White wolves have the statistics of a Wolf (see page 327) with Weapon Skill 45, Willpower 35, and the Bite +6, Frenzy, Magical, and Size (Large) Creature Traits.

spells.name: Pelt of the Winter Wolf
spells.text: Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours Your bellowed prayers bring Ulric’s attention, allowing your target to survive the bite of his realm. While they still feel the pain and discomfort caused by cold and wintry weather, they suffer no mechanical penalties.

spells.name: The Snow King’s Judgement
spells.text: Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You call on Ulric to make manifest his disdain for the weak, the cowardly, and the deceitful. The target’s blood and marrow freeze, causing 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armour Points. For every SL, you may cause 1 additional Wound. If the GM rules that the target is neither weak, cowardly, nor deceitful, you suffer the effects instead.

spells.name: Ulric’s Fury
spells.text: Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds You chant furious prayers, and Ulric’s ferocity spreads. An ally may take a free Frenzy Test (see page 184) on their Turns. However, instead of granting a free attack, Frenzy adds +1d10 Damage to the first melee hit they make on their Turn. If they roll 10, they keep rolling, adding more Damage each time, until they roll less than 10.

spells.name: Winter’s Bite
spells.text: Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds You roar prayers concerning Blitzbeil, Ulric’s ever-thirsty axe. If wielding an axe, it counts as Magical, causes an additional +SL Damage, and any targets struck gain a Fatigued Condition. Further, struck targets lose any Bleeding Conditions as their blood freezes; similarly, attacks from your axe cannot cause any Bleeding Conditions.

spells.name: As Verena Is My Witness
spells.text: Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds By calling Verena as your witness, the truth of your words shines out for all to see. For the duration of the Miracle, provided you speak only the truth, all listeners will believe you speak truly. This does not necessarily mean they will agree with your conclusions, of course.

spells.name: Blind Justice
spells.text: Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds You articulate prayers concerning Verena’s acute perceptions, able to pierce through to the truth of all things. You may make a Challenging (+0 SL) Perception Test to see through Spells and Miracles involving illusion or misdirection. You may also make an Average (+2 SL) Intuition Test to tell whether a character speaking to you is lying. Note: This will only tell you if the character believes they speak the truth; it will not alert you if they are mistaken.

spells.name: Shackles of Truth
spells.text: Range: Fellowship Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds Your appeal to Verena, requesting her judgement concerning a suspected criminal. If your target committed a crime and claims they did not, they gain an Entangled Condition that cannot be removed for the duration. If you have falsely accused the target, Verena is displeased with your lack of wisdom: you must immediately roll on the Wrath of the Gods table.

spells.name: Sword of Justice
spells.text: Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds You pray to Verena to guide your blade to strike down the unjust. If wielding a sword, it ignores Armour Points and counts as Magical. Further, if struck opponents are criminals (as determined by the GM), they must make an Average (+2 SL) Endurance Test or suffer the Unconscious Condition that lasts for at least Fellowship Bonus Rounds. If any crime is perpetrated on the unconscious opponents, you suffer +1 Sin Point per crime.

spells.name: Truth Will Out
spells.text: Range: Fellowship Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You intone prayers of Verena’s ability to find any truth. You may ask the target a single question. It will be immediately answered truthfully and fully. The target may resist with an Opposed Average (+2 SL) Cool Test against your SL. If they win, they may stubbornly refuse to answer. If they achieve +2 SL, they may withhold minor information. +4 SL allows them to withhold significant information, while +6 SL allows them to lie outright. You will know if they resist successfully, though you will lack specific knowledge about their deceit, or proof of their dishonesty.

spells.name: Wisdom of the Owl
spells.text: Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds You call on Verena to instil you with her wisdom and knowledge. You gain +20 Intelligence and you may ask the GM the likeliest outcome of one of your immediate decisions with the facts you have available. Further, your pupils dilate widely, and your gaze becomes piercing and unsettling: gain +1 Acute Sense (Sight), Menacing, and Night Vision Talents.

spells.name: Animal Friend
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: 1 hour You make friends with a creature that is smaller than you and possesses the Bestial Creature Trait. The animal trusts you completely and regards you as a friend.

spells.name: Bearings
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant You sense the influx of the Winds of Magic from their source. You know which direction north is.

spells.name: Careful Step
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Agility minutes The magic flowing through your feet ensures any organic matter you tread upon remains undamaged: twigs do not break, grass springs back to its original position, and even delicate flowers are unharmed. Those seeking to use the Track Skill to pursue you through rural terrain suffer a -3 SL penalty to their Tests.

spells.name: Conserve
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus days You preserve up to a day’s worth of rations. During this time they will not rot, develop mould, or go stale, although they can still be harmed by external factors, such as getting wet or being burned or poisoned.

spells.name: Dart
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You cause a small dart of magical energy to fly from your fingers. This is a magic missile with a Damage of +0.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds The target gains 1 Blinded Condition, and gains 1 Blinded Condition at the start of each Round for the duration of the Spell.

spells.name: Drain
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant You touch your target, draining their life. This counts as a magic missile with Damage +0 that ignores Armour Points. You then heal 1 Wound.

spells.name: Eavesdrop
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Initiative yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes You can hear what your target says as if you were standing right next to them.

spells.name: Gust
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You create a brief gust of wind, strong enough to blow out a candle, cause an open door to slam, or blow a few pages to the floor.

spells.name: Light
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes You create a small light, roughly equivalent to a torch, which glows from your hand, staff, or some other part of your person. While the Spell is active, you may choose to increase the illumination to that of a lantern, or decrease it to that of a candle, if you pass an Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test.

spells.name: Magic Flame
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You kindle a small flame that flickers to life in the palm of your hand. It will not burn you, but will emit heat and set flammable objects alight, like a natural flame.

spells.name: Marsh Lights
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes You create a number of flickering magical lights up to your Intelligence Bonus. They resemble torches or hooded lanterns. Provided they remain within line of sight, for your Action you may control the lights by passing an Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test; a success allows you to send the lights moving in any direction. They will move at walking pace in a straight line, passing through any objects (or witnesses) in their path, unless you Test again to change their direction.

spells.name: Murmured Whisper
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You cast your voice at a point within Willpower yards, regardless of line of sight. Your voice sounds from this point, and all within earshot will hear it.

spells.name: Open Lock
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant One non-magical lock you touch opens.

spells.name: Produce Small Animal
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant You reach into a bag, pocket, or hat, or under a rock, bush or burrow, producing a small animal of a type you would expect to find in the vicinity, such as a rabbit, dove, or rat. If there are no appropriate local animals, the Spell does nothing. The temperament of the animal is not guaranteed.

spells.name: Protection from Rain
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus hours You can keep yourself and your possessions dry whatever the weather, unaffected by precipitation. This affects rain, hail, sleet, and snow, and any similar water falling from the heavens, but not standing water.

spells.name: Purify Water
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Instant You purify all water within a receptacle, such as a water flask, stein, or jug. All non-magical impurities, such as poison or contaminants are removed, leaving crisp, clear, potable water. If the vessel contains another liquid that is predominantly water — such as ale or wine — this is also purified, turning into delicious, pure, non-alcoholic water.

spells.name: Rot
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Instant You cause a roughly fist-sized volume of organic material to immediately rot. Foodstuffs perish, clothes crumble, leathers shrivel (losing 1 Armour Point on 1 Hit Location), and similar, as dictated by the GM.

spells.name: Shock
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant Your target receives 1 Stunned Condition.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You touch the target, sending them into a deep sleep. If the target has the Prone Condition, they gain the Unconscious Condition as they fall asleep. They remain unconscious for the duration, although loud noises or being moved or jostled will awaken them instantly. If your targets are standing or sitting when affected, they start themselves awake as they hit the ground, gaining the Prone Condition, but remaining conscious. If your target is not resisting, and is suitably tired, they will pass into a deep and restful sleep.

spells.name: Sly Hands
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant You teleport a small object — no bigger than your fist — from about your person into your hand.

spells.name: Sounds
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You create small noises nearby. You can create quiet, indistinct noises that sound as if they come from a specific location within range, regardless of line of sight. The noises can evoke something specific, such as footsteps, whispers, or the howl of an animal, but nothing so distinct that it might convey a message. While the Spell is active, you may control the sounds by passing an Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test. A success allows you to move the sounds to another point within range, or to increase or decrease their volume.

spells.name: Spring
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You touch the ground and water bubbles forth at the rate of 1 pint per Round, to a total of your Initiative Bonus in pints.

spells.name: Twitch
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Half Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You cause a small object to move, slightly. Something may fall from a shelf, or a book may slam its pages shut. If the object is held, the holder must pass an Average (+2 SL) Dexterity Test or drop the object.

spells.name: Warning
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant You channel magic into an object, noticing immediately if it has been poisoned, infected, or trapped.

spells.name: Aethyric Armour
spells.text: CN: 2 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You gain +1 Armour Point to all Hit Locations as you wrap yourself in a protective swathe of magic.

spells.name: Aethyric Arms
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You conjure a Magical melee weapon of your choice from among the weapons in page 301.

spells.name: Arrow Shield
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Any missiles containing organic matter, such as arrows with wooden shafts, are automatically destroyed if they pass within the Area of Effect, causing no damage to their target. Missiles comprising only inorganic matter, such as throwing knives and pistol shots, are unaffected.

spells.name: Blast
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant You channel magic into an explosive blast. This is a magic missile with Damage +3 that targets everyone in the Area of Effect.

spells.name: Bolt
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You channel magic into a damaging bolt. Bolt is a magic missile with a Damage of +4.

spells.name: Breath
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant Choose a target within 20 + Willpower Bonus yards and make a Challenging (+0 SL) Ballistic Skill Test. The target, and any creature within Initiative Bonus yards of them, may oppose your result with a Dodge Test. Those who fail to beat your result are struck by this spell. Breath inflicts Willpower Bonus Damage. The effects of this spell vary depending on the Lore used to cast it. 0 Acid (Metal): Damage is increased by 4. Weapons and armour carried by affected targets each suffer 1 Damage. 0 Cold (Beasts, Light, Necromancy): Damage is increased by 2. Targets gain a Fatigued Condition. Until it is removed, their weapons gain the Slow Flaw. 0 Electricity (Heavens): Damage is increased by 2. Damage ignores metal armour. Targets gain a Stunned Condition. 0 Fire (Fire, Daemonology, Waaagh!, and Tzeentch Chaos Lores): Damage is increased by 5. Targets gain an Ablaze Condition.

spells.name: Bridge
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You create a bridge of magical energy, with a maximum length and breadth of your Willpower Bonus in yards. For every +2 SL, you may increase length or breadth by your Willpower Bonus in yards.

spells.name: Chain Attack
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You channel a twisting spur of rupturing magic into your target. This is a Damage +4 magic missile. If Chain Attack deals more Wounds than the target’s Toughness Bonus, it leaps to the nearest other target within Willpower Bonus yards of the previous target, inflicting –1 Damage each time. It may leap a maximum number of times equal to your Willpower Bonus. For every +2 SL achieved, it may chain to an additional target.

spells.name: Corrosive Blood
spells.text: CN: 2 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness Bonus Rounds or hours You infuse yourself with magic, lending your blood a fearsome potency. You gain the Corrosive Blood Creature Trait (see page 357) for Toughness Bonus Rounds. Alternatively, for Toughness Bonus hours, all small parasites (fleas, leeches, etc.) that bite you instantly die and transmit no disease. Blood Rot and similar diseases are purged from your body.

spells.name: Dark Vision
spells.text: CN: 1 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds You boost your Second Sight to assist your mundane senses. While the Spell is active, gain the Dark Vision Creature Trait (see page 357).

spells.name: Distracting
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You wreathe yourself in magic, which swirls around you, distracting your foes. While the Spell is active, gain the Distracting Creature Trait (see page 358).

spells.name: Dome
spells.text: CN: 7 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You create a dome of magical energy overhead, blocking incoming attacks. Anyone within the Area of Effect gains the Ward 6+ Creature Trait (see page 363) against Magical or ranged attacks originating outside the dome. Those within may attack out of the dome as normal, and the dome does not impede movement.

spells.name: Drop
spells.text: CN: 1 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You channel magic into an object being held by the target creature. This could be a weapon, a rope, or someone’s hand. Unless a Challenging (+0 SL) Dexterity Test is passed, the item is dropped. For every +2 SL, you may impose -1 SL on the Dexterity Test.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Using magic, you entrap your target, wrapping them in whatever suits your Lore: vines, shadows, their own clothing… Your target gains one Entangled Condition with a Strength equal to your Willpower.

spells.name: Fearsome
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Shrouding yourself in magic, you become fearsome and intimidating. Gain Fear 1. For every +3 SL, you may increase your Fear value by 1.

spells.name: Flight
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You can fly, whether by sprouting wings, ascending on a pillar of magical light, or some other method. Gain the Fly (Athletics) Creature Trait (see page 358).

spells.name: Magic Shield
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You encase yourself in bands of protective magic. While the Spell is active, add +Willpower Bonus SL to any dispel attempts you make.

spells.name: Move Object
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: 1 Round Using magic, you grab hold of a non-sentient object no larger than 1 + SL yards in any dimension, moving it with the sheer force of your will, which is considered to have a Strength equal to your Willpower. You may move the object up to Willpower Bonus yards. If anyone attempts to impede the object’s movement, make an Opposed Willpower/Strength Test. For every +2 SL, you may increase the distance the object is moved by Willpower Bonus yards.

spells.name: Mundane Aura
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes You drain all the Winds of Magic from within your body and your possessions, removing any magical aura. For the duration of the Spell, you appear mundane to the Magical Sense Talent and similar. You effectively have no magical ability and your magical nature cannot be detected by any means. While this Spell is in effect, you cannot cast any other Spells. Mundane Aura immediately ends if you make a Channelling Test.

spells.name: Push
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards, maximum) Duration: Instant All targets around you are pushed back your Willpower Bonus in yards, take 1d10 Damage ignoring Armour Points, and gain the Prone Condition. If they collide into a creature the same Size or smaller, that creature gains the Prone Condition (but takes no Damage). For every +2 SL, you may push creatures back another Willpower Bonus in yards.

spells.name: Silence
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes You create a zone around you through which no noise can travel. Within the zone, no sound can be heard, and people outside the zone cannot hear anything emanating from it. This interferes with the casting of Spells: the Difficulty of Casting Tests increases by one step.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant Using magic, you can teleport up to your Willpower Bonus + SL in yards. This movement allows you to traverse gaps, avoid perils and pitfalls, and ignore obstacles.

spells.name: Terrifying
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You become a terrifying horror to your enemies. You gain the Terror 1 Creature Trait (see page 362). For every +3 SL, you may increase your Terror value by 1.

spells.name: Ward
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You wrap yourself in protective magic, gaining the Ward 7+ Creature Trait (see page 363).

spells.name: Amber Talons
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Your nails grow into wickedly sharp talons of crystal amber. Your unarmed attacks lose Undamaging, gain Magical, have a Damage of SB + 4, and inflict 1 Bleeding Condition whenever they cause Wounds. Further, gain Scale Sheer Surface (see page 125).

spells.name: Beast Form
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness minutes You infuse your very bones and flesh with Ghur, warping your body into that of an animal. When cast, select a new form from any in the Beasts of the Reikland section of the Bestiary (see pages 325-327). You gain all the creature’s standard Traits except the Bestial and Skittish Traits. Furthermore, replace your Movement, Strength, Toughness, Agility, and Dexterity with the creature’s. Recalculate your Wounds. For every +2 SL, you may include 1 of the creature’s Optional Creature Traits except Size (Enormous). While transformed, you look like a normal version of the animal, with amber and brown colouring. You cannot speak, cast Spells, or dispel. Critical Wounds and lost Wounds carry over when you revert to your true form, but you cannot be reduced below 0 Wounds in this way.

spells.name: Beast Master
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days Your breath steams and your eyes take on a shining amber sheen as Ghur suffuses you. Your gaze and words convince a creature with the Bestial and Size (Small, Average, or Large) Traits that you are its pack master. It fights to the death to protect you. While subject to your mastery, the beast follows your commands, instinctively understanding simple instructions. If the Spell ends, the creature retains enough respect and fear not to attack you unless compelled to. Your allies may not be so fortunate.

spells.name: Beast Tongue
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes You can commune with all creatures possessing the Bestial Trait. Ghur clogs your throat, and your language comes out as snarls, hisses, and roars as befits the beasts to whom you speak. While the creatures are not compelled to answer you or do as you bid, most hear you out. You gain +2 SL on all Animal Training and Charm Animal Tests. While this Spell is active, you may only speak with beasts — you may not speak any civilised tongues and can only communicate with your party using gestures. You cannot cast Spells or dispel while Beast Tongue is active.

spells.name: Flock of Doom
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You call down a murder of crows or similar local birds to assail your foes. The flock ferociously attacks everyone in the Area of Effect who lacks Arcane Magic (Beasts) , inflicting a Damage 7 hit to the head at the end of each Round. The birds also cause them to suffer 1 Blinded Condition while within the area as they peck at their eyes. As an Action, you may make an Average (+2 SL) Charm Animal Test to move the flock to another area within range.

spells.name: Hunter’s Hide
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You cloak yourself in a shimmering mantle of Ghur. You gain +20 Toughness, the Acute Sense (Smell) Talent (see page 114), and the Dark Vision and Fear 1 Creature Traits (see page 358).

spells.name: The Amber Spear
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Strength yards Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant You hurl a great spear of pure Ghur with uncanny accuracy. This is a magic missile with a Damage of +12, ignoring AP from armour made of leather, fur, scales, and similar. You may choose its Hit Location, and it also inflicts +1 Bleeding Condition.

spells.name: Wyssan’s Wildform
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You call on the wild power of Ghur to infuse you, surrendering to its savage delights. Gain +1 Movement, +30 Strength and Toughness, and the following Creature Traits (see pages 356–361): Belligerent, Bite (Strength Bonus + 1), Fear 1, Frenzy, Magical, Striding Gait (Woodland). While the Spell is active, you are incapable of using any Language or Lore Skills.

spells.name: Caress of Laniph
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant Reaching out an ebon hand, you draw out your target’s soulstuff. This is a magic missile with a Damage of +6 that ignores TB and AP. For every 2 Wounds you inflict, you permanently reduce the target’s maximum Wounds by 1 and may add 1 SL to your channelling pool. You must use your hand for the Touch Test, not an enchanted staff.

spells.name: Dying Words
spells.text: CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Touching the body of a recently departed soul (one that passed away within the last day), you call its soul back briefly. For the Spell’s duration, you can communicate with the dead soul, though they cannot take any action other than talking. They are not compelled to answer you, but the dead do not lie.

spells.name: Purple Pall of Shyish
spells.text: CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You pull about you a pall fashioned from fine strands of Shyish. Gain +WPB Armour Points on all Locations and the Fear 1 Creature Trait (see page 358). For every +2 SL, you may increase your Fear rating by 1.

spells.name: Sanctify
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower minutes Inscribing a magical circle, you ward it with Shyish, forming an impenetrable barrier to the undead. Creatures with the Undead Creature Trait cannot enter or leave the circle.

spells.name: Scythe of Shyish
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You conjure a magical scythe. It acts like a Magical Halberd with a Damage of SB + WPB + 4. Undead enemies do not receive Advantage when Engaged with you.

spells.name: Soul Vortex
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant You hurl a shimmering ball of Shyish which erupts into purple flames, swirling with ghostly faces, mouths agape in silent terror. Targets within the Area of Effect receive +1 Broken Condition. Targets with the Undead Creature Trait take a magic missile hit with a Damage of +10 that ignores Toughness Bonus and Armour Points.

spells.name: Steal Life
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant Thin strands of purple mist connect you briefly to your target, who wastes away before your very eyes. This counts as a magic missile with a Damage of +6 that ignores Armour Points. Furthermore, you lose all Fatigued Conditions, and for every 2 Wounds you inflict, you may heal 1 Wound.

spells.name: Swift Passing
spells.text: CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant Your touch brings the release of death to a single creature standing at Morr’s threshold. If the target has 0 Wounds remaining, death swiftly follows. Furthermore, they cannot be raised as Undead.

spells.name: Aqshy’s Aegis
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You wrap yourself in a fiery cloak of Aqshy, channelling flame into an aegis. You are completely immune to damage from non-magical fire and ignore any Ablaze Conditions you receive. You receive the Ward 7+ Creature Trait (see page 363) against magical fire attacks, including warpfire and Spells from the Lore of Fire.

spells.name: Cauterise
spells.text: CN: 2 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant Channelling Aqshy through your hands, you lay them on an ally’s wounds. The target heals 1 Wound, or 1 + SL Wounds if they have Arcane Magic (Fire), and removes all Bleeding Conditions. Furthermore, their wounds will not become infected. Targets without Arcane Magic (Fire) must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test or scream in agony. On an Astounding Failure, the target gains a Stunned Condition and is permanently scarred.

spells.name: Crown of Flame
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You channel Aqshy into a majestic crown of inspiring fire about your brow. You gain +1 War Leader Talent (see page 128) and the Fear Trait (see page 358). For every +2 SL, you may increase your Fear value by 1 or take War Leader again. Furthermore, gain a +1 SL bonus on all Channelling and Casting Tests using Aqshy.

spells.name: Firewall
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Special) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You channel a streak of Aqshy, creating a wall of flame. The firewall is Willpower Bonus yards long, 1 yard high, and 1 yard deep. Anyone crossing the firewall gains 1 Ablaze Condition and suffers a magic missile hit with a Damage of +WPB. You can add extra Area of Effect with Overcasting to multiply its length.

spells.name: Flaming Hearts
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant Your voice takes on a rich resonance, echoing with Aqshy’s fiery passion. Allied characters lose all Broken and Fatigued Conditions and may take a Frenzy Test (see page 184).

spells.name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 sword (Hand Weapon) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You wreathe a sword in magical flames. The weapon has Damage SB + 6 and the Damaging and Magical Qualities (see page 304). Hits with the blade inflict 1 Ablaze Condition. If a wielder lacks Arcane Magic (Fire) and they Fumble an attack with the flaming sword, they gain 1 Ablaze Condition.

spells.name: Great Fires of U’Zhul
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 (maximum) + AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You hurl an explosive blast of Aqshy. The flames erupt into a furious blaze, burning with the heat of a forge. The central target suffers a magic missile hit with Damage +10 that ignores AP and inflicts 2 Ablaze Conditions and the Prone Condition. Other targets in the Area of Effect suffer a Damage +5 magic missile hit ignoring AP. The Spell stops behaving like a magic missile as the fire continues to burn in the Area of Effect for the duration. Anyone within the Area of Effect at the end of a Round suffers WPB + 5 Damage, ignoring AP, and gains 1 Ablaze Condition.

spells.name: Purge
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You funnel intense flame to burn away corruption in an area. Anything flammable is set alight, and any creatures in the area take +SL Ablaze Conditions. If the location contains a Corrupting Influence, such as Dhar, warpstone, or a Chaos- tainted object, it smoulders and blackens, beginning to burn away. You can maintain Purge in subsequent Rounds with your Actions by passing a single Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling (Aqshy) Test, but must pass a Difficult (-1 SL) Endurance Test every 30 minutes or gain a Fatigued Condition; a Failure (-1 SL or worse on the Endurance Test) ends the Spell. The precise time needed to eliminate the Corrupting Influence is determined by the GM. As a rough guideline, a small quantity (smaller than an acorn) of warpstone, or a minor Chaos-tainted object may require 10 - Willpower Bonus Rounds (minimum of 1 Round). A fist-sized chunk of warpstone or a more potent Chaos-tainted object may require double the amount of time. A powerful Chaos artefact may take hours or longer. See page 187 for details on Corrupting Influences.

spells.name: Cerulean Shield
spells.text: CN: 7 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You encase yourself in a crackling cage of sparking electricity and Azyr. For the Spell’s duration, gain +3 Armour Points to all Locations against metal weapons — such as daggers, swords, and arrows with metal tips. If struck by metal melee weapons, your attacker takes 6 Damage to their striking arm.

spells.name: Comet of Casandora
spells.text: CN: 16 Range: Initiative yards Target: AoE (2 x Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Special You channel all the Azyr you can muster and reach out to the skies, calling down a comet to wreak havoc amongst your foes. Select a target area of impact. At the end of the next Round, make a Very Hard (-3 SL) Ballistic Skill or Average (+2 SL) Lore (Astronomy) Test. For every +SL you achieve on the Ballistic Skill or Lore Test, you may move your area of impact by Willpower Bonus yards. For every -SL, the GM moves the area of impact by 1d10 yards in a random direction. Comet of Casandora then acts as a magic missile with Damage +18 that hits all targets in the Area of Effect. Targets also gain 1 Ablaze Condition and the Prone Condition.

spells.name: Coruscating Arc
spells.text: CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant A crackling bolt of chain lightning shoots from your fingertips, scything through the enemy’s ranks. Coruscating Arc acts like Chain Attack (see page 243), except its Damage is +10 and it inflicts 1 Blinded Condition.

spells.name: Fate’s Fickle Fingers
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds All allies within the Area of Effect, excluding those with the Arcane Magic (Heavens) Talent, create a single pool of Fortune Points. All may draw on the pool; first come, first served. When the Spell ends, you reallocate any remaining Fortune Points as fairly as possible.

spells.name: Starcrossed
spells.text: CN: 7 Range: Initiative yards Target: 1 Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds You can spend Fortune Points to force the target to reroll Tests.

spells.name: The First Portent of Amul
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds You read signs about what the future holds. For the duration of the spell you gain +1 Fortune Point. For every +2 SL, you may gain +1 more.

spells.name: The Second Portent of Amul
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus Rounds You divine clues as to forthcoming events. For the duration of the spell you gain 1 + SL Fortune Points. For every +2 SL, you may gain +1 additional Fortune Point.

spells.name: The Third Portent of Amul
spells.text: CN: 12 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Rounds You divine a portent of doom. For the duration of the spell you gain +1 Fate Point. MYSTICS The Mystic career can gain access to the Arcane Magic (Heavens) Talent. Mystics who take that Talent can only take these Spells: Fate’s Fickle Fingers, Starcrossed, The First Portent of Amul, The Second Portent of Amul, The Third Portent of Amul. To gain access to the rest of the Lore of Heavens, they would need to enter a suitable spellcasting career.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.text: CN: 3 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You cause the target’s skin to become hard and rough like the bark of a tree. The target gains +2 Toughness Bonus, but suffers -10 Agility and Dexterity.

spells.name: Earthblood
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You draw up wholesome energies from the soil. To cast this Spell, you must be in direct contact with the earth — either touching it, or standing barefoot. Any living creatures in direct contact with the earth within the Area of Effect heal WPB Wounds at the start of every Round.

spells.name: Earthpool
spells.text: CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant After successfully casting Earthpool, you immediately disappear into the ground in a wild torrent of Ghyran. You appear at the start of the next Round at any point within range, erupting from the earth violently. Any creature you erupt under is thrown back 1 yard in a random direction and falls Prone. This Spell will not allow you to move through solid rock, but will allow you to move through water.

spells.name: Fare of the Land
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days You flood the target’s body with nourishing Ghyran. The target need not eat or drink. They still excrete as normal, though their leavings are verdant green.

spells.name: Forest of Thorns
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds This Spell may only target a patch of earth. You cause a dense knot of wickedly spiked brambles and tangled vines to burst upwards, covering the Area of Effect. For the duration, anyone without the Arcane Magic (Life) Talent attempting to traverse the area on foot must make a Hard (-2 SL) Athletics Test. If they fail, they gain 1 Bleeding Condition and 1 Entangled Condition with a Strength equal to your Willpower. After the Spell ends, the growth remains but loses its magical properties.

spells.name: Lie of the Land
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: You Duration: Special Touching the earth, your senses flow through the Ghyran tracing the nearby area. After communing for 1 minute, you receive a mental map of natural features — land, forests, rivers — within range. Settlements may be alluded to as areas of clear terrain or trenches. If you increase the range using Overcasting, the time it takes to commune with the land increases by 1 minute for each SL.

spells.name: Lifebloom
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You cause Ghyran to flood an area that is blighted or desolate. As examples of the Spell’s power, you may target either a dry riverbed, well, field, or a domestic animal. If you successfully cast the Spell, the target bursts to life: 0 A dry river begins to flow once again. 0 A dry or polluted well becomes clean and fresh. 0 A planted field, vineyard, or orchard bursts into life, with all its crops immediately reaching full ripeness. 0 A sick or unproductive animal is cured of all diseases and becomes energetic and eager once more.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Your target gains the Regeneration Creature Trait (see page 360).

spells.name: Banishment
spells.text: CN: 12 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant You open your hands and a cleansing halo of Hysh issues forth, affecting all creatures within the Area of Effect whose Toughness is lower than your Willpower. Targets with the Daemonic or Undead Creature Trait gain the Unstable Creature Trait (see page 363). If they already have the Unstable Trait, they are reduced to 0 Wounds.

spells.name: Blinding Light
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant You emit a blinding flash of light from your hand or staff. Everyone looking at you within WPB yards receives 3 Blinded Conditions unless they possess the Arcane Magic (Light) Talent.

spells.name: Clarity of Thought
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes You calm your target’s mind, allowing them to think clearly. The target ignores any negative modifiers to their mental processes, such as Conditions like Stunned, Mental Mutations, Psychologies, and so forth while the Spell is in effect.

spells.name: Daemonbane
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Daemon Duration: Instant You summon a blast of Hysh that passes through the border between the Realm of Chaos and the material world. If the target’s Toughness is higher than your Intelligence but less than double, halve their maximum Wounds for the rest of the encounter. If lower, you banish them with a blinding white light Everyone looking at a banished daemon from Willpower yards away receives 3 Blinded Conditions, unless they possess the Arcane Magic (Light) Talent.

spells.name: Healing Light
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant Your target glows with a cleansing light, healing Intelligence Bonus Wounds and removing poisons and intoxicants. If you pass a Very Hard (-3 SL) Channelling (Hysh) Test, 1 Corruption Point gained in the last hour is also lost.

spells.name: Net of Amyntok
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Intelligence Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence Bonus Rounds You cast a net woven from strands of Hysh over your target, whose mind is overcome with conundrums and puzzles, leaving them paralysed with indecision. Target loses their Move and gains +1 Stunned Condition, which they cannot lose while the Spell is active. When recovering from the Condition, targets Test their Intelligence instead of the Endurance Skill. Bestial creatures are immune to this Spell.

spells.name: Phâ’s Protection
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You summon a protective aura of pure holy light. Creatures with the Daemonic or Undead Creature Trait and those with mutations cannot enter the Area of Effect — those already within the area gain a Broken Condition until they leave. Creatures within the area cannot gain any Corruption Points while the Spell is active.

spells.name: Speed of Thought
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds A lattice of Hysh overlays your mind, allowing you to think rapidly. Gain +20 to Intelligence and Initiative.

spells.name: Crucible of Chamon
spells.text: CN: 7 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 object Duration: Instant You channel Chamon into a single non-magical, metallic object, such as a weapon or piece of armour covering a single body part. The item melts, dripping to the floor as molten metal, cooling almost immediately. If held, the item is dropped. If worn, the wearer takes a hit like a magic missile with Damage +WPB that ignores Armour Points. While the object is destroyed, the metal retains its base value, and may be used by a smith as raw material.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You encase a single non-magical weapon with heavy bands of Chamon, enhancing its potency. For the duration of the Spell, it gains +WPB Damage and the Magical and Unbreakable Qualities (see pages 304–305). For every +3 SL, you may also add 1 Weapon Quality or remove 1 Weapon Flaw while the Spell is active.

spells.name: Feather of Lead
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: Area of Effect (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Calling on the Golden Wind, you alter the density of your target’s belongings, raising or lowering their weight. For the duration of the Spell, choose one effect for everyone within the area of effect: 0 Count as two steps more Overburdened. 0 Do not count as Overburdened. See page 299 for details on Encumbrance.

spells.name: Fool’s Gold
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower minutes You weave Chamon into a non-magical object made of metal, fundamentally altering its nature. For the duration of the Spell, all metal in the object becomes gold. This is not an illusion: it has transformed into gold. When the Spell ends, the item reverts to its original metal. This Spell can ruin good weapons, make armour too heavy to wear, and turn lead coins into something more appealing.

spells.name: Forge of Chamon
spells.text: CN: 9 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes You alter the quality of a metal item. You may add 1 Item Quality or remove 1 Item Flaw. For every +2 SL, you may add another Item Quality or remove another Item Flaw.

spells.name: Glittering Robe
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You conjure a shimmering, luminous cloak of scales that dazzles the enemy. The robe emits as much light as a candelabra, you gain +2 AP to all Locations, and any enemies Engaged with you must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test of suffer 1 Blinded Condition.

spells.name: Mutable Metal
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You touch a non-magical object made of metal, which instantly becomes warm to the touch as you squeeze Chamon into it. You may bend and mangle the object with your bare hands. If you wish to make a more complex alteration and the GM agrees, you may attempt a pertinent Average (+2 SL) Art or Trade Test instead, depending on what you are trying to achieve.

spells.name: Transmutation of Chamon
spells.text: CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You wrench Chamon from the metals worn by your foes, and the earth itself, briefly transforming the flesh of your enemies into metal. This is a Damage +WPB magic missile affecting all in the Area of Effect; the Spell ignores TB and AP and inflicts +1 Blinded, Deafened, and Stunned Condition, all of which last for the duration. All affected targets gain +1 AP from the gold wrapped about their bodies, but also endure Suffocation (see page 169). If targets die while the Spell is in effect, they are permanently encased in a shell of base metals, a macabre reminder of the risks of sorcery.

spells.name: Choking Shadows
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You wrap shadowy tendrils of Ulgu around your foes’ necks. They suffer 1 Fatigued Condition, cannot talk, and suffocate (see page 169).

spells.name: Doppelganger
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus minutes You weave a cloak of Ulgu, assuming the likeness of another humanoid creature with whom you are familiar (as determined by the GM). Your appearance fools anyone without the Second Sight Talent, though some may note if your mannerisms are incorrect. Those with Second Sight must win an Opposed Difficult (-1 SL) Intuition Test against the Casting Test to notice the disguise.

spells.name: Illusion
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Intelligence Bonus yards) Duration: Intelligence minutes You spin a web of intricate strands of Ulgu, obfuscating the Area of Effect with an illusory image of your choosing. You automatically fool anyone without the Second Sight Talent. Those with that Talent must win an Opposed Difficult (-1 SL) Intuition Test against the Casting Test to notice the illusion. This does not let them see through the Spell or end its effects — they merely understand it is an illusion. The illusion is typically unmoving. For your Action, you may make a Hard (-2 SL) Channelling (Ulgu) Test to make the illusion move within its space for that Round.

spells.name: Mindslip
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes You conjure delicate threads of Ulgu in your target’s mind, causing all prior memory of you to disappear for the Spell’s duration. Once the Spell is over, if you wish, the target must win an Opposed Average (+2 SL) Intelligence Test against the Casting Test or the memory loss becomes permanent until dispelled.

spells.name: Mystifying Miasma
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You conjure forth a swirling mass of mist shot through with roiling shadows that confounds the senses. Anyone within the mist without the Arcane Magic (Shadows) Talent is affected by the miasma, gaining 1 Blinded, Deafened, and Fatigued Condition, which remain for the Spell’s duration. Affected creatures that attempt to use their Move must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Perception Test or gain the Prone Condition.

spells.name: Shadowsteed
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Until the next dawn You summon forth a shadowy steed. The creature’s unnatural flesh is black as midnight, and at times it appears to be both solid and insubstantial. Use the rules for a riding horse (see page 327). When the shadowsteed is out of sunlight, it gains the following Creature Traits (see page 356): Dark Vision, Ethereal, Fear 1, Magical, Painless, and Ward 9+. Even when insubstantial, shadowsteeds may be ridden. Riders with the Arcane Magic (Shadow) Talent have a bonus of +2 SL to Ride Tests to ride a shadowsteed. Those without the Talent suffer a penalty of -2 SL. Shadowsteeds are tireless and need neither rest nor sustenance. As the first rays of dawn break over the horizon, the steeds melt into insubstantial mist. If the Spell ends while a shadowsteed has a rider, the rider suddenly falls and suffers falling damage (see page 169).

spells.name: Shadowstep
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant You create a shadowy portal of Ulgu through the Aethyr. You disappear from your current location and immediately appear up to Willpower yards away. Any enemies Engaging you when you disappear gain the Surprised Condition.

spells.name: Shroud of Invisibility
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You wrap the target in a shroud of Ulgu. The target becomes invisible and cannot be perceived by mundane senses. The Spell automatically fools anyone without Second Sight. Those with the Sight must win an Opposed Perception Test against the Casting Test to notice that someone is nearby, though they will not be able to pin down the precise location. Targets are still perceptible to the other senses. The Spell ends if the target brings attention to themself by making loud noises or attacking someone.

spells.name: Goodwill
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes You create an atmosphere conducive to friendliness and good spirits. All Fellowship Tests within the Area of Effect receive +1 SL, and Animosity and Hatred Psychologies have no effect.

spells.name: Halétha’s Joy
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours You plead with a god of fertility to bless the target. While the Spell is active, if biologically possible, they will conceive a child. The Spell ends when used.

spells.name: Mirkride
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes Speaking ancient words of magic, your spirit leaves your body, stepping into the Hedge, the dark space between the material world and the spirit realm. For the duration, you stand apart from the world, able to witness it invisibly and completely silently, but not affect it in any way. Your spirit self has the Ethereal Trait (see page 358). Your body remains in place, immobile and insensate. If you take any Magical damage, it instead immediately ends the Spell. You can see and interact with spirits, other Ethereal creatures, and daemons, even invisible ones, and vice versa. At the end of the Spell, you are pulled suddenly back to your body. If your body is killed while you are walking the Hedge, your spirit will wander aimlessly for eternity.

spells.name: Nepenthe
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus hours As you chant your incantations over a cup, a thick mist issues from your mouth and coalesces as a thick, silver liquid. A character who drinks it within the duration may choose to completely forget one individual, permanently.

spells.name: Nostrum
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Dexterity Bonus hours You incant a spell over a prepared draught, imbuing it with magical power. If drunk while the Spell is active, the drinker immediately heals Dexterity Bonus Wounds and is cured of one disease of the GM’s choice. For every +2 SL, you may cure an extra disease.

spells.name: Part the Branches
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative minutes Your pupils dilate as you complete your incantation, allowing you to see into the spirit world. This allows you to see all invisible creatures.

spells.name: Protective Charm
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus days You imbue a charm, such as a small piece of jewellery or pocket- sized trinket, with a spell of protection. Those bearing the charm gain +2 SL to resist magical effects and Corruption.

spells.name: Shepherd’s Eye
spells.text: CN: 0 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant This spell is most often used to find lost livestock, but is easily put to other uses. You grab a bit of organic matter belonging to a single creature — wool, blood, a piece of their leavings — and add it to a bowl of water. After scrying into the bowl for 10 - IB minutes, secret symbols appear to your sight: the GM will describe the creature’s location. If you are familiar with the location, you know where they are.

spells.name: Blight
spells.text: CN: 14 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You cause an area to become blighted or desolate. For example you may target either a tavern, well, field, or a domestic animal. If you successfully cast the Spell, the target suffers from a blight: 0 All food and drink in a blighted tavern immediately spoils. 0 A blighted well becomes instantly brackish and stagnant. 0 Any crops currently planted in a blighted field rot overnight. 0 A blighted animal sickens. The afflicted beast no longer produces anything (cows produce no milk, coats and hides grow mangy and unusable) and will die in 10 - SL days.

spells.name: Creeping Menace
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You summon a swarm of creeping, slithering creatures to harass your foes. Each target affected is immediately Engaged by a swarm of Giant Rats, Giant Spiders, or Snakes (your choice of one creature type). Use the standard profiles for the relevant creature type, adding the Swarm Trait. For your Action, you may make a Challenging (+0 SL) Charm Animal Test to direct one or more swarms to attack a different target. When the Spell ends, any remaining swarms disappear into the shadows.

spells.name: Curse of Crippling Pain
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Stabbing a crude representation of your target — a doll or puppet — you inflict crippling pain. When successfully cast, choose which Hit Location to stab: 0 Body — Target doubles up in agony, gaining +1 Fatigued, and must pass a Hard (-2 SL) Endurance Test or fall Prone. 0 Head — Target gains a Stunned Condition, and must pass an Average (+2 SL) Endurance Test or gain -SL additional Stunned. 0 Limb — Limb becomes useless, as if amputated (see page 177). Fatigued and Stunned last for the duration. You may stab the doll again to affect an additional, unaffected Location by using an Action to take an Average (+2 SL) Channelling Test.

spells.name: Curse of Ill Fortune
spells.text: CN: 8 Target: 1 Range: Willpower yards or Willpower Bonus miles (with ingredient) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes or days (with ingredient) The target suffers bad luck. Laces snap, chairs break, and other minor narrative effects inconvenience them. They suffer -1 SL to all Tests and cannot spend Fortune. If they have no Fortune, they reroll all Test rolls of 01–05. This Spell’s ingredient, something belonging to the target (such as a personal possession or strand of hair), lets you ignore line of sight.
spells.duration: Willpower Bonus minutes or days (with ingredient)

spells.name: Glamour
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 adult Duration: Willpower Bonus hours You alter the target’s appearance to look however old you wish, within the normal range of adulthood.

spells.name: Haunting Horror
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower days You target a single location, such as a house or clearing, and inflict haunting dreams and waking nightmares on any who enter there. Those entering while the Spell is active are unnerved by eerie sensations, flitting shadows, and whispered voices lurking on the threshold of hearing. Unless they are witches or their familiars, they gain +1 Fatigued Condition. Then, unless they pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Psychology Test, they gain another Fatigued Condition and a Broken Condition, both of which are only removed upon leaving the location.

spells.name: Make Hale
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant Your hands glow with a soothing, pale yellow light and the target relaxes. They heal WPB Wounds and lose 1 Fatigued and 1 Stunned. With +3 SL, you may change Range to Willpower Bonus yards, causing streams of light to leap from your fingers and twist through the air.

spells.name: The Evil Eye
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: 10 yards (maximum) Target: 1 (maximum) Duration: Instant You lock eyes with the target and wither their psyche. Perform an Opposed Intimidate/Cool Test, adding any SL from the Casting Test to your result. If you win, the target suffers Fear 1 from you and gains 1 Fatigued Condition, plus 1 Fatigued per +3 SL by which you win. If you win by 6+ SL, they gain 1 Broken Condition.

spells.name: Destroy Lesser Daemon
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Size (Average) or smaller Daemon Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Your Spell disrupts the Dhar holding a daemon together and draws it back to you. The target makes an Opposed Easy (+4 SL) Endurance Test against the Casting Test. If you win, you immediately destroy the target and you may increase one of your Characteristics by +10 for the duration as you syphon profane energies from your victim.

spells.name: Detect Daemon
spells.text: CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant Your Spell homes in on the daemonic influences in the surrounding area. You automatically know if there is a manifested daemon within range, be it summoned, bound into an artefact, possessing another, or similar.

spells.name: Manifest Lesser Daemon
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You channel a sickening flow of Dhar, briefly forcing a rent into the fabric of reality. A Lesser Daemon immediately manifests through the rent (see page 349 for two examples: a Bloodletter or a Daemonette). Perform an Opposed Channelling (Dhar)/ Cool Test with the daemon. If successful, the daemon will respond to one command issued by you, quite literally, then vanish (assuming the command is completed before the Duration ends). If failed, the daemon immediately attacks.

spells.name: Octagram
spells.text: CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Intelligence Bonus yards across, maximum) Duration: Willpower minutes Daubing an octagram to the floor, and marking it with unholy symbols, you ward against all daemonic influence. Those with the Daemonic Trait cannot enter or leave the octagram.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.text: CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise You channel a heavy flow of Dhar into bare earth, causing old bones to gather and rise. 1 + SL Skeletons (see page 339) claw upwards into the affected area at the end of the Round, which are organised as you prefer within the Area of Effect. They start with the Prone Condition. The summoned undead are entirely under your control and can perform simple orders as you command. If you are killed or gain the Unconscious Condition, the Spell comes to an end and the summoned undead collapse. For each +2 SL, you may summon an extra Skeleton.

spells.name: Reanimate
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise You channel worming strands of thick Dhar before you, sinking it into corpses, reanimating that which was once dead. Reanimate WPB + SL dead bodies (as Zombies, see page 340) or skeletons (as Skeletons, see page 339) within range. They start with the Prone Condition. The summoned undead are entirely under your control and can perform simple orders as you command. If you die or gain an Unconscious Condition, the Spell comes to an end and the reanimated corpses fall dead again. For each +2 SL, you may reanimate an extra WPB + SL Skeletons or Zombies.

spells.name: Screaming Skull
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You shriek the high-pitched words of the spell and a large, black skull wreathed with greenish-purple fire forms before you, then flies forwards, screaming and cackling as it goes. The skull moves in a straight line for the Spell range, following the contours of the land, passing through any obstacles in its way. Screaming Skull is a magic missile with Damage +WPB that only affects targets without the Undead Creature Trait. Any suffering Wounds from the Spell must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Psychology Test or take a Broken Condition.

spells.name: Vanhel’s Call
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You manipulate complicated flows of Dhar into your targets, filling them with overwhelming energy. Intelligence Bonus targets with the Undead Trait gain a free Move or Action — choose one to affect all targets — taken the moment the Spell is cast. For each +2 SL, you may invigorate an extra Intelligence Bonus targets.

spells.name: Festering Inflammation
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You conjure up septic fluids in the wounds of your opponent. One of the target’s Wounds becomes a Festering Wound.

spells.name: Miasma of Pestilence
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds A thin mist gathers around you. All living creatures within the Area of Effect must pass a Hard (-2 SL) Endurance Test or suffer from the Nausea Symptom (see page 182). Those dedicated to Nurgle, and skaven plague monks, are not affected.

spells.name: Stream of Corruption
spells.text: CN: 9 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant Your maw distends horrifically before you vomit forth a foul stream of diseased filth and horror. Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack (see page 357). It counts as a magic missile with a Damage equal to your Toughness Bonus, and it ignores Armour Points. Further, any targets that take more than their TB in Wounds must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test or contract Blood Rot (see page 179).

spells.name: Acquiescence
spells.text: CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Your magic pierces deep within your target, flooding their senses with strange, euphoric sensations. At the start of each Round, the target must make a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test. If they fail, they lose their Move and Action as they are overwhelmed with blissful sensation.

spells.name: From Pain, Pleasure
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You confound the target’s senses, transforming pain to pleasure. The target gains the Painless Creature Trait (see page 360) for the duration of the Spell. As they endure injuries, they experience a wave of pleasurable sensation. Should they suffer a Critical Wound, they must pass an Average (+2 SL) Endurance Test or drop their weapons, standing Helplessly as their enemies rain blows down upon them, lost in the ecstatic rending of their own flesh.

spells.name: Phantasmagoria
spells.text: CN: 8 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds In response to your invocation, unearthly visions of beguiling and fearsome creatures fill the area of effect, giving you and all allies the Distracting Creature Trait (see page 358) for the duration of the Spell. Targets do not distract one another.

spells.name: Boon of Tzeentch
spells.text: CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus days The Changer of the Ways twists your mind, granting you access to arcane knowledge. Choose one Spell from any Lore. For the Duration, you may cast it as if you had memorised it, but may not record it in a grimoire. If you channel to cast the new Spell, you may use either Channelling (Dhar) or the Channelling Skill appropriate to the Spell, should you possess it. If you suffer a Miscast when casting this new Spell, Boon of Tzeentch quits your mind in disgust, and also erases itself from your grimoire should it have allowed itself to be recorded there.

spells.name: Transformation of Tzeentch
spells.text: CN: 12 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds At your command, bonds of aethyric fire coil from the earth, shrouding your target in a cocoon of magical energy. The target gains the Prone Condition and is considered Helpless for the duration. At the end of each Round, they must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test or gain 1 Corruption Point.

spells.name: Treason of Tzeentch
spells.text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Intelligence Bonus Rounds You channel fine strands of traitorous thoughts into your targets’ minds, twisting their motivations and fanning fires of discontent. Targets gain Animosity (Allies). Further, unless immune to that Psychology, they cannot transfer Advantage to their allies and, if they score a Critical when attacking, they must pass a Hard (-2 SL) Cool Test or target their nearest ally.

doomings.text: The witch’s word shall write your doom.
Beware the sign of the crimson sun.
Thine mind lingers overlong in the land of dreams.
Tread not upon the tender roots of sleeping trees.
Trust not the signs of Ranald.
Hold thine breath under Morrslieb’s light, lest darkness take root in thine soul.
Fear the land bereft of the seagull’s cry.
Be thou impious upon a Mondstille night and thou wilt never see another.
Trust not in the strength of bridges if the day be a Festag.
The children of Ulric call, with haste thou wilt fall.
A night without song precedes a morning without waking.
For the want of a key, that’s the ending of thee.
An ogre may name you his most valuable boon and yet remain an ogre.
It ringeth once: peace. It ringeth twice: pleasure. It ringeth thrice: death.
The Twisted Puppeteer doth pull thy strings and thus conjure up the end of things.
Ottokar dared to court the divine, but to do so is no right of thine.
Recall young Tomas and provoke not the beast of the woods.
Be thou circumspect when carousing with dwarfs.
Plague and dark disease shall bring thee quickly to thy knees.
The sword shalt deliver no justice, only thine end.
The sticky bun! The pork pasty! The eel and leek pie! Lo, they are Morr’s dishes!
Strain thou not the patience of the weary Shallyan.
A lurker in goblin shape waits to waylay every treasure seeker.
Recall Baron Trister and honour thy debts.
Keep the relic of a crow’s skull upon thee, lest thee drink poison and perish.
When thou wager with elves, win thou may, lose thou may, but cheat thou not.
Laugh not in the face of the flatulent lest thine own guts fester.
Never was there one such as thee, who drowned on land and not at sea.
As new life cries out, Father Morr shall welcome thee.
Heed the siren’s trilling, or soon your heart lies still.
Rise not before Cacklefax’s calling, for thine death is early indeed.
Morr sends a maiden.

notes: Fifth Edition core creation and advancement govern. Existing Talents use core definitions; approved older names are mapped explicitly.
User approved Fifth Edition Skill allocations with printed Tilean choices and native Tilean language; core Human physical attributes remain unchanged.
Keep core statistics and add only new equipment. No alternative armoury or older Talent replacement is enabled.
Crew Commander is visible but unavailable until its repeat limit and Test bonus are converted by agreement.
Printed numeric Test modifiers remain in reference descriptions by user decision. Explicit old Advantage references use Momentum under core Appendix I p. 364.
An optional Career refinement unavailable to the Species retains the original legal Career and logs the rejected result, per user instruction.
Only character-creation material is integrated. Injury, mounted combat, Pursuits, group Advantage, hireling management, structure damage and Warrior Endeavours remain outside this creator.
Unpriced descriptive Trappings and unspecified ammunition quantities remain unresolved rather than invented.

talents.name: Crew Commander
talents.text: Printed Fourth Edition reference: Max: Initiative Bonus. Tests: Ranged Skill tests when firing a weapon with the Crewed Flaw. A Character with this talent is practised at managing crews of siege weapons and artillery pieces. The Character may make a Challenging (+0) Leadership Test to help a crew manning a weapon with the Crewed Quality within earshot. If the Character passes the Test, the crew members may then use the Character’s Ranged Skill when shooting the weapon.
talents.unavailable: Unavailable: Crew Commander has no Fifth Edition core equivalent. Its Fourth Edition repeat limit and Talent Test bonus need an agreed conversion (Up in Arms p. 140).
talents.conversion: User requested that this Talent remain visible but greyed out until its Fifth Edition conversion is agreed. No purchase, free grant or repeat bonus is enabled.

spells.name: Command the Legion
spells.text: Myrmidia carries your orders across the battlefield. You may issue a command to any ally within line of sight. The command must be relevant to the accomplishment of an armed struggle or ongoing strategy. Any Leadership Tests you make as a result benefit from a +10 bonus.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

spells.name: Dismay Foe
spells.text: You embody Myrmidia in her most wrathful of aspects. Gain the Terror 1 Creature Trait.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

spells.name: In Good Order
spells.text: Knowing that the situation is hopeless you pray that your forces do not suffer from a disastrous rout. While the miracle is in play any allies may break from combat without allowing the enemy to gain Momentum or make free attacks (the printed Fourth Edition cross-reference is Fleeing, WFRP p. 165).
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses. The old Advantage reference becomes Momentum under Fifth Edition Appendix I p. 364; the old page reference is labelled.
spells.adaptation: Fourth Edition Advantage references converted to Momentum (core Appendix I).

spells.name: Know Your Enemy
spells.text: You call on Myrmidia to inform you of a nearby enemy’s strengths and weaknesses. The GM should allow you to check the profile, traits, skills and talents of the target.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

spells.name: On Deadly Ground
spells.text: Knowing that victory cannot be secured unless your forces stand firm you call on Myrmidia to banish all thoughts of retreat from the minds of your allies. Whilst the miracle is in effect your allies do not receive Broken Conditions.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

spells.name: Quick Strike
spells.text: Infused with Myrmidia’s power, you benefit from heightened reflexes and can anticipate your opponent’s moves. At the start of every round whilst the Miracle is in effect, you may attempt a Challenging (+0) Initiative Test to gain an immediate free attack outside the normal turn sequence. This attack is resolved with whatever weapon you are carrying in your primary hand.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

spells.name: Shieldmaiden’s Devotion
spells.text: Your chanted prayers fill the hearts of the faithful with the fearlessness of her bravest Shieldmaidens. All Myrmidians within range gain +1 Fearless (Enemy) Talent. This enemy may either be a particular individual, or a particular species.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

spells.name: Skill of Combat
spells.text: You embody in your allies the skill of Myrmidia. Whilst this Miracle is in effect, all allies in range benefit from a +10 bonus to their WS and BS.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

spells.name: Vengeful Wrath
spells.text: You are filled with the righteous indignation of Myrmidia. Whilst this Miracle is in effect, you must charge and attack the nearest unrepentant enemy. You may reroll any Melee Skill rolls you make whilst the Miracle is in effect.
spells.conversion: Printed numeric modifiers retained in the description by user decision; situational effects are reference text, not automatic character bonuses.

notes: Current Fifth Edition creation allocations, advancement and core Talent definitions govern.
Clan profiles use the user-approved five-Talent adaptation: omit old Small, use Resistant (Chaos), one clan choice and one random Talent; Mootish is recorded as Haffennaff.
Fearless without a printed group offers core enemy choices. Savant (Moot terrain) uses Savant (Moot); Savant (Dwarf Holds and Routes) retains the core owned-Lore requirement.

User approved all three Eonir kindreds with Wood Elf starting attributes; Cityborn follows High Elf Careers and records its kindred on the Class line. Younger receives the additional Youngblood Talent, maximum 1.
Existing core equipment is unchanged. New profiles retain printed properties; contextual combat effects are described. Challenging (+0) becomes +0 SL under core Appendix I p. 364.
If Up in Arms is also enabled, its Precision Shot and Powder price (3 shillings, p. 102) takes precedence over this book's 3-penny price (p. 93), by user instruction.
Only creator-relevant material is integrated. NPCs, settlements, adventure hooks and campaign activity remain outside this character creator.
Descriptive or unpriced Trappings retain their printed names; no missing weights, prices, quantities or animal statistics are invented.

talents.name: Youngblood
talents.text: Max: 1. Tests: Any Social Tests with other Eonir. Your family are considered newcomers to the Laurelorn and are treated with condescension by Eonir of the older birth kindreds. You are always considered of lower Status than other Eonir, unless they also have the Youngblood Talent. Second generation Youngbloods can lose this Talent by passing a trial to join the Forestborn Kindred.

mechanics.gmApproval: No Ogre may take writing, complex-artistry or suitably advanced Lore Skills/Talents without GM permission (Archives II p. 21). Confirm with your GM which of your choices need permission and obtain it before finishing creation.

magicReferences.text: Ogre Casting uses Toughness for Language (Magick). Spellcasting requires meat as part of the cost of living; without suitable meat the Ogre loses Wounds equal to the spell’s CN. This ordinary meat does not reduce Miscast risk. Esoteric ingredients can be acquired or bought for 1 shilling per CN. The page also states that casting without a suitable ingredient costs Wounds equal to CN; retain that wording for GM adjudication. These are play references, not automatic Wounds or coin deductions.

Great Maw Lore: after successfully casting a Lore spell, roll 1d10. A 10, or a result at least equal to its unmodified CN, restores Wounds equal to that unmodified CN. Channelling or a Grimoire does not lower the CN used for this benefit. Ingredients are bloody animal parts, unusual bile, marrow or cured fat. This is a play reference, not automatic healing.

talents.name: Vice (Target)
talents.text: Max: Willpower Bonus Tests: Willpower (Resist Target) You are consumed with a need to indulge in a particular vice, suffering from the Vice Psychology. Each time you take this Talent you develop a new vice. Examples you could take include: Alcohol, Food, Narcotics, Pleasure. NEW PSYCHOLOGY: VICE You are plagued by a need to indulge in your Vice constantly, with your thoughts always straying towards them. Indulging in your Vice must be to an unhealthy extent — indulging in food doesn’t mean having a meal, but being a glutton and eating everything you can until you are bloated and made sick. Whenever you are confronted by the Target of your Vice, you must attempt a Psychology Test (WFRP, page 190). If you fail, you must immediately indulge in your Vice, forsaking all other actions and duties. You indulge until you are insensible, gaining one Fatigued Condition. At the end of every subsequent Round, you may attempt another Psychology Test to bring this state to an end. You suffer –20 to all Fellowship Tests towards any Characters who have witnessed your gluttony, as they are repulsed by your behaviour. For each full day you spend having not indulged in your Vice, you gain a cumulative –20 to all Psychology Tests until you do so.
talents.conversion: Printed Vice Psychology is reference text, not a campaign tracker or permanent Fellowship adjustment. Species grants Vice (Food). No old per-rank SL Talent bonus is imported.

spells.name: Bonecrusher
spells.text: You crunch loudly on a mouthful of bones while snarling a curse at a nearby foe. Bonecrusher is a magic missile with a Damage of +4 which ignores your target’s Armour Points but not their Toughness Bonus. Additionally, if your attack inflicts a Critical Wound, add +20 to the roll on the appropriate Critical Wound table to determine its severity.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here.

spells.name: Bullgorger
spells.text: You devour the heart of a mighty beast, projecting its strength and power onto a nearby creature. For the spell’s duration, your target adds +2 to their Strength Bonus for the purposes of Damage they inflict or for other appropriate feats of Strength. However, when the spell ends, they find themselves consumed by an immense hunger and must immediately gorge themselves on a substantial meal or gain a Fatigued Condition. If the target wishes to reject your gift, they may attempt a Difficult (−1 SL) Cool Test to ignore its effects.
spells.conversion: Current core Creature Traits apply; old page references identify Fourth Edition. Numeric effect modifiers remain printed unless explicitly converted here. User resolves conflicting Difficult (+20) by the difficulty label: Difficult (−1 SL).
